title: Senior Data Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own our batch platform. You will work in Python and SQL, run Airflow, and model the warehouse in dbt. Must have: 5+ years building production data pipelines, strong SQL, experience with a cloud warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake). Nice to have: Kubernetes, streaming experience with Kafka. The team ships analytics for 4 million monthly users and is currently fighting a nightly job that fails twice a week.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: Analytics Engineer to build the semantic layer for our clinical reporting product. Stack: dbt, Snowflake, Python, Looker. You will partner with clinicians to turn messy source systems into models people trust. Must have: dbt in production, advanced SQL, an eye for data quality. Nice to have: healthcare data, dagster.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Ranking
description: Join the ranking team. You will own feature pipelines and model serving for the recommendation surface. Must have: Python, experience shipping ML models to production, comfort with large-scale data processing (Spark or Flink). Nice to have: ranking or search background, Kubernetes. We serve 30k requests per second at peak.
